examples: Turn VoiceOver on in the desktop app and open a session: the terminal reads out new output.
Set terminal screen reader mode to on in a browser tab, where the app cannot tell a screen reader is running.
how_to: Open settings, terminal, and find terminal screen reader mode under accessibility.
Leave it on auto and the desktop app follows VoiceOver; pick on or off to force it. Every open terminal follows at once.
media_exempt: the control is three radio rows and the effect is an accessibility tree, which a screenshot does not show
name: Terminal screen reader mode
summary: a terminal turns on xterm's screen reader mode when the computer reports a running screen reader, or when the setting forces it on or off.
